title: Menu Items: Links, Content Items, HTML and Permissions | Orchard Core
description:
A menu in Orchard Core is a list of menu items, and the type of an item decides where it links and who sees it.

The Menu module provides a Link Menu Item for an address you type, a Content Menu Item for a content item you pick, and an Html Menu Item for a link with HTML as its text. Link and Html items can require permissions, and Content items can check who may view the content they point to.

In this video:
• The three types of menu item, and who sees them
• Adding an item from the menu editor
• A Link Menu Item
• A Content Menu Item
• An Html Menu Item
• Restricting an item with permissions
• Publishing the menu, and checking it as an administrator and as a visitor
